title: Pure Danger!
summary: Danger! cards only, with generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Every Danger! monster reveals itself so the opponent picks a random card from your hand to discard. If it isn't that monster, it summons itself and draws, and if it is, its own discard effect fires instead. Either way you profit. Danger! Nessie! searches a Danger! card when discarded, Jackalope? summons a Danger! from the Deck, Bigfoot! destroys a face-up card, and Thunderbird! destroys a Set card. Danger! Excitement! Mystery! discards a big Danger! to search a small one. Danger! Disturbance! Disorder!, the newest card, destroys what beats your Danger! in battle and banishes three Danger! Spells/Traps to wipe the field.
